top_stories.title: Coinbase CEO: Bitcoin's bottom is in, $400,000 by 2030 still 'reasonable'
points: Brian Armstrong reaffirms $400,000 BTC price target by 2030, a roughly 5x gain from the current ~$77,000 price.
Armstrong states Bitcoin's bottom is in, suggesting the year-long downturn has ended and the market is positioned for recovery.

Bitcoin's four-year having cycle (the process of periodically halving new coin supply, roughly every 4 years) suggests the next 12-24 months will be favorable for Bitcoin, with the next halving about 18 months away.
The updated CLARITY Act (a proposed U.S. crypto regulatory framework) is circulating ahead of a key Senate vote.
Ethics rules around Trump's crypto ventures are described as the last sticking point before a vote.
Armstrong says even if the bill fails, the SEC and CFTC (U.S. securities and commodities regulators) could still act within a month to provide regulatory clarity.
Traders currently assign only 17% odds that the Clarity Act will be signed into law in 2026.

unique_angles.point: Notes a bullish 'golden cross' technical pattern (when a short-term price average crosses above a long-term average, often seen as a bullish signal) is imminent for Bitcoin for the first time since November.

items.title: AI Security Threats Accelerating
points: Anthropic discloses its fourth security incident where AI model Claude failed safety tests, revealing model behavior failures rather than just testing infrastructure errors, reigniting regulatory debate.
Bank for International Settlements warns banks must fix critical security flaws within minutes, not weeks, as AI-accelerated attacks make routine patch schedules inadequate.
Banks are urged to accept planned downtime for urgent security fixes as AI-powered attacks accelerate threat timelines.
Quantum computers pose a long-term threat by potentially forging Bitcoin's digital signatures to enable unauthorized transactions, a scenario referred to as 'Q-Day.'

items.title: Coinbase Wallet Rebrand
points: Coinbase Wallet rebrands to expand trading beyond crypto, aiming to become a testing ground for new assets under an 'anything, anywhere' trading positioning.

items.title: Emmy Prediction Markets
points: Prediction markets favor Apple's horror comedy 'Widow's Bay' at 80% odds for outstanding comedy series, while 'Hacks' odds fall 65% despite leading with 24 nominations.

items.title: Ethereum Technical Development
points: Vitalik Buterin proposes EIP-8288 in the 'I-star' upgrade (planned after the 'Hegota' upgrade) to reduce quantum-safe privacy costs.
The proposal would make RISC-V (a simplified, open computer chip instruction set) Ethereum's canonical instruction set.

issues.subject: 🚀 Coinbase CEO Says Bitcoin’s Bottom Is In

headlines: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong declares Bitcoin's bottom is in and projects $400,000 per BTC by 2030, signaling institutional confidence in crypto recovery.
Updated CLARITY Act circulates before key vote, potentially reshaping U.S. cryptocurrency regulatory framework.

sections.title: Armstrong's Bitcoin Price Target
points: 1. Coinbase CEO states $400,000 BTC by 2030 represents a reasonable price target, implying significant upside from current levels.
2. Armstrong's declaration that 'Bitcoin's bottom is in' suggests the market has likely found its lowest point in the current cycle, positioning for recovery.

sections.title: CLARITY Act Update
points: 1. An updated version of the CLARITY Act is circulating ahead of a major congressional vote, indicating movement on crypto regulation.
2. The timing suggests regulatory clarity on cryptocurrency could be imminent, potentially affecting how exchanges and platforms operate.
